title: Mashle Season 3 Confirms Crunchyroll Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content: Mashle: Magic and Muscles is gearing up for its highly anticipated return for a third season next year, and has now confirmed its release date ahead of its launch with Crunchyroll.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Sells Over 5.2 Million Units to Become Nintendo's Fastest-Selling Switch 2 Game
content: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launched on November 5. The remake adds traditional camera controls, motion controls, a proper jump button, and a roll dash action. Players can equip an item to the controller's ZR button, and switch between them in a pop-up menu.
author: ANN

title: South Park Teases Tweek x Craig Return in New Season 29 Episode First Look Trailer – Watch Now
content: South Park Season 29 has been going back to its roots with all of its episodes so far, and the next episode is promising another return with the first look at a new Tweek and Craig episode coming our way.

title: CyberAgent Announces Business Alliance With Animation Studio MAPPA
content: Media advertising company CyberAgent announced on Wednesday that it has entered into a business alliance agreement with animation studio MAPPA , and has acquired a stake in MHD Co., MAPPA 's parent company.
author: ANN

title: 'Mashle: Sanma Taisou Shinkakusha Saishuu Shiken-hen' Reveals Additional Cast, Promo
content: The official website of the Mashle ( Mashle: Magic and Muscles ) television anime revealed additional cast pair, a key visual and a promotional video for its third season on Wednesday. The new season is scheduled to premiere on January 10 at 12.00 a.m.

title: Elden Ring: Distant Tales Between Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: Haruichi 's Elden Ring: Distant Tales Between ( Elden Ring: Tōki Hazama no Monogatari ) comedy manga , based on Bandai Namco and FromSoftware 's Elden Ring game, announced on October 19 that it will end in its next chapter.

title: Sayaka Mogi's Happy Hypoxia Manga Ends
content: Futabasha 's Web Action manga website released the 15th and final chapter of Sayaka Mogi 's Happy Hypoxia -Haiiro no Ko- (Happy Hypoxia -The Grey Child-) manga on Tuesday. The manga centers on Miyuki, a woman who has undergone fertility treatment for eight years and has just finally given birth.

title: Black Clover Season 2 New Noelle Battle Visual Spotlights Her Valkyrie Dress Form
content: Black Clover Season 2 revealed its second “Most Fearsome Battle Visual,” this time featuring Noelle Silva. The visual shows Noelle after forming a contract with Undine and activating the Saint Valkyrie Dress. The visual is the second entry in the campaign, while the first visual featured Asta in his Devil Union form .
